name: polaris-work
description: The working-life half of Polaris: a dated briefing across every work source, a daily journal, OKR pace, and a manager 1:1 prepared from state you already have.

notionParentPageId.title: Sweep Notion parent page
notionParentPageId.description: Page id or url that /sweep writes each dated briefing under. One value for every project.

timezone.title: Your timezone
timezone.description: IANA name used to bound each day for /sweep and /journal, for example Asia/Kolkata.

maxLookbackHours.title: Sweep maximum lookback (hours)
maxLookbackHours.description: Ceiling on how far back /sweep pulls when it has not run in a while.
